Chapter 01

About This Guide

What this document is for, who it is written for, and how it maps to your onboarding journey.

1.1 Purpose

This guide is for organisations being onboarded onto the Songa Mobility platform as tenants. It explains what the platform is, how your organisation is structured within it, what happens during the setup process, and how you manage your team once you are live.

Each section maps directly to a step in your onboarding journey — from the first conversation to your team being active on the platform.

1.2 Your Journey at a Glance

1
General Details

2
Modules

3

4

6

Prepared by Antarctica Global: Your entire onboarding is handled by the Antarctica Global team, based on the requirements gathered during your onboarding conversation. You do not need to interact with the admin interface yourself.

Chapter 02

What is Songa Mobility

A hub-based clean energy and mobility platform that connects fleet management, agri-tech operations, and IoT hardware into a single system.

2.1 Platform Overview

Songa Mobility is a hub-based clean energy and mobility platform. It is used to manage fleets of electric vehicles, agri-tech equipment, battery assets, and the drivers and agents who operate them — all from a single connected system.

2.2 Three Layers

Web Application
The management interface used by hub managers and administrators. This is where trips are planned, assets are tracked, revenue is managed, and operations are monitored in real time.
Mobile Application
Used by drivers and field agents to execute trips, sessions, and rentals in the field.
IoT Integration
The platform connects to physical hardware — vehicles, batteries, chargers, and hub energy systems — making the web interface a live mirror of what is happening on the ground.

2.3 How Data Flows

Every operation on the platform — a trip completed, a battery charged, a session conducted — generates structured data that flows into financial calculations. The platform is built around one core principle:

Physical events become digital records, and digital records drive payments, commissions, and reporting. Nothing is manual — every chargeable event is captured automatically at the point of operation.
Home › Chapter 3
Chapter 03

Your Organisation on the Platform

Songa Mobility is a multi-tenant platform. Your organisation has its own fully isolated environment — your data, your users, your configuration.

3.1 What "Tenant" Means

In platform terminology, your organisation is referred to as a tenant. Your tenant is a self-contained instance of the Songa platform — configured specifically for your operational requirements, with your own modules, roles, users, and settings.

Think of it as your own version of the platform, hosted within a shared infrastructure. You see only your data. Your team accesses only your environment. No information is visible to or shared with any other organisation on the platform.

3.2 What You Get

When your organisation is onboarded, the following are configured specifically for you:

Modules
The sections of the platform relevant to your operations — for example, fleet management, rentals, or agri-tech sessions. You only see what is enabled for your organisation.
Permissions
Within each module, specific features can be switched on or off — for example, whether your team can modify vehicles, manage geofences, or add assets to service.
Roles
Your team members are assigned roles that determine exactly what they can see and do. Roles are created for your organisation and are not shared with anyone else.
Notifications
You choose which events trigger notifications and on which channels — email, web app, or mobile app.

4.1 What Happens

Setting up your organisation on the platform is a structured, six-step process. Songa's admin team completes this on your behalf, based on the requirements gathered during your onboarding conversation. Step 1 captures your organisation's basic information and the details of your primary point of contact.

Super Admin: The contact person entered in this step becomes the Super Admin for your organisation — the first user, with the highest level of access. They will receive an invitation email once setup is complete.

4.2 Fields Collected

FieldDescription
Organisation NameThe name of your organisation as it will appear on the platform.
First Name / Last NameThe name of your designated Super Admin — your primary administrator.
Email AddressThe Super Admin's email. An invitation is sent here once setup is complete.
Contact NumberPrimary contact number for your organisation.

5.1 Module Categories

CategoryModulesPurpose
AssetsVehicles, KilikawiManage your fleet of trikes and agri-tech equipment.
OperationsTrips, Sessions, RentalsExecute and track the three core operation types.
Energy ManagementHubs, Chargers, BatteriesMonitor and manage energy across hub stations.
Management CentreUsers, Requests, Locations, QR Codes, ServicesManage your team, incoming requests, and locations.
FinanceRevenue Manager, Rates ManagerConfigure rates and track payments.
OtherMobile AppEnable mobile access for drivers and field agents.
Always on: Two modules — Home and Settings — are enabled for every organisation and cannot be removed. Home is the platform command centre; Settings handles account and user management.

5.2 Suites and Packages

To simplify selection, modules are available in pre-configured groupings called Suites and Packages. Selecting a Suite automatically enables the relevant modules for that operational category. Individual modules can then be adjusted from there.

Asset Management Suite Agri Business Suite Value Chain Package Agri-Tech Activities Package

5.3 Module Dependencies

Some modules depend on others to function. Where a dependency exists, the supporting module is automatically enabled and cannot be deselected independently. For example, enabling Trips automatically enables Vehicles and Locations, as both are required for trips to operate.

6.1 What Permissions Control

Each module has a set of configurable permissions that determine what actions are available to your organisation. Examples include:

  • Vehicle records — Whether your team can modify vehicle records or view them only.
  • Trike override actions — Whether mobilise / immobilise and tracker switch are available.
  • Geofences — Whether your team can create and manage geofences for vehicles.
  • Service management — Whether assets can be added to service from the web platform.
  • QR codes — Whether QR codes for vehicles and assets can be viewed and printed.
Scoped to your modules: Only permissions for your enabled modules appear at this step. If a module is not part of your configuration, its permissions are not shown.

Step 5 — Roles

Roles define what each member of your team can see and do on the platform. Two roles are created automatically; additional roles can be added to match your team structure.

8.1 Automatic Roles

Two roles are created automatically for every organisation:

Hub Manager
The primary operational administrator at a hub. Has broad access across assets, trips, users, and configuration.
Driver
Created when Trips or Sessions are enabled. Has access to the mobile app and the operations they are assigned to.

8.2 Custom Roles

Additional roles can be created to match your team structure. Each role is configured at the level of individual actions within each module — for example, whether a role can add, edit, or delete a vehicle record; whether it can perform IoT override actions; or whether it has view-only or no access to a given section.

Your roles only: Roles are specific to your organisation. A role created for your tenant does not exist or apply anywhere else on the platform.

Chapter 10

Managing Your Organisation

Once your organisation is live, your configuration, users, and roles can be updated at any time. You are not locked into your initial setup.

10.1 Your Users

All users in your organisation are listed on your tenant's detail page. Each user entry shows their name, email address, contact details, assigned role, and the date they were onboarded.

User roles can be changed at any time. If a team member's responsibilities change, their role can be updated directly from this view — no need to remove and recreate the user.

10.2 Your Roles

All roles configured for your organisation are visible on the Roles tab of your tenant page. Each role entry shows how many users are assigned to it and when it was created.

Roles can be edited at any time — permissions can be adjusted as your team structure or operational requirements change. New roles can also be added after initial setup.

10.3 Tenant Settings

The Tenant Settings link on your organisation's page provides access to your full module and permission configuration. Songa's admin team can modify your enabled modules, adjust feature permissions, update rules, and reconfigure notifications at any time.

Immediate effect: Any changes to your module or permission configuration take effect immediately across the platform. If a module is disabled, it is removed from view for all users in your organisation at once. Data is never deleted — re-enabling a module restores full visibility.

Getting Support

Your fresh platform instance, ready to go — and where to turn if you need help.

11.1 A Fresh New Instance

Once all of the information is added and your organisation is created, you will be able to access a fresh new dashboard with all modules configured and ready to be set up as per your requirements. Your Super Admin takes ownership from this point, beginning by inviting the rest of the team.

11.2 Getting Support

For any queries related to your organisation's configuration, user access, or platform setup, contact your Antarctica Global point of contact directly.

Antarctica Global Technology and Consulting is the exclusive technology partner for Songa Mobility, responsible for all platform development, configuration, and support. All onboarding, configuration changes, and technical queries are handled directly by the Antarctica Global team.
